Bambu Studio's built-in defaults for settings that Bambu's own presets leave unset and that
Slyce defaults differently. Without these the same preset slices differently in the two apps.
Found by diffing the effective config both apps embed in their G-code for the same P1S and P2S
case (Bambu Studio 02.09.01.70). Only settings with the same key and meaning in both apps are
listed; values use Slyce's enum names (Bambu's 'zig-zag' is ipRectilinear, Slyce's 'rectilinear').
bbl_profiles.py sync writes each into the named base preset when that file does not set it.
